title: Green Heart Sunflowers - 2x Plug Plants - Unusual Sunflower Variety
description:
2x Green Heart Sunflowers


 Green Heart bears creamy-yellow blooms with a bold green center from July to October. Ideal for borders, beds, and cutting. Height: 140 cm.



 When Planting out:


 - Spacing 20-36 inches between plants

- Depth: Plant to original soil level


- Light: Full sun


- Support: Stake in exposed or windy sites


- Pests: Protect young plants from slugs/snails





- If nights are cool, keep plugs above \(10^\circ\text{C}\) until hardening off


- Optimal active growth temperatures: \(20\text{–}30^\circ\text{C}\)
